bullets: A mod menu for Gorilla Tag
Works on both PC and VR
sections.note: This tutorial will guide you through the basics. You can view it again anytime from the Settings tab.

bullets: Wrist Menu: Physical menu on your wrist (VR)
Text UI: Floating text menu controlled by joystick (VR)
PC UI: Traditional window with tabs (PC)
sections.note: Switch UI type in: Modules > Core > UI > Settings > UI Type. The following pages explain each UI in detail.

bullets: Hold X button (default) to show the menu
Menu appears attached to your wrist
Release the button to hide the menu
Configurable for left or right hand
Use your other hand to touch buttons
Or enable laser pointer mode for interaction
6 buttons per page for categories/modules
Use arrows to change pages
Home button returns to category view
Touch a module button to toggle on/off
Green = enabled, Grey = disabled
Darker colors = requirements not met
Adjust position offsets and rotation in settings
Scale the menu size up or down
Switch between hand-touch and laser interaction

pages.title: Text UI (VR)
pages.subtitle: Floating text menu with joystick controls

bullets: Joystick Up/Down: Navigate through lists
Joystick Click: Select/Confirm
B Button: Go back
Joystick Left/Right: Quick toggle or adjust values
Categories shown at top level
Press down/click to enter a category
Modules listed vertically (6 per page)
Press down again to view module settings
Left/Right on joystick to change values
Hold joystick for 1.5s to reset all module settings
Quick press resets individual setting
Choose left or right joystick for navigation
Adjust UI distance and vertical offset
Enable/disable smooth scrolling
Press F1 to toggle PC UI visibility
Drag the title bar to move the window
Click X to close
Category tabs filter modules by type
Search bar to find modules by name
Click checkbox to enable/disable
Click 'Settings' arrow to expand module options
Use sliders, +/- buttons, and arrows to adjust values
Shows all players in the room with previews
Click a player for live camera view
Action buttons: Teleport, and more
Room: View current room, join/create by name, disconnect
Settings: Export/Import settings, restore backups
View Tutorial or Changelog buttons available
Core: Essential systems (UI, Pointer System)
Movement: Fly, Noclip, Platforms, Speed, and more
Visual: ESP, Tracers, Nametags, Skeleton ESP
Misc: Utility features and tools
Trolling: Fun modules for messing around
sections.note: Some modules may have requirements like being in a room or specific game mode.

pages.title: Using Modules
pages.subtitle: How to toggle and use modules

bullets: Click a module name to toggle it on/off
Green = enabled, Grey = disabled
Some modules show requirements when they can't be used
Requirements include: being in a room, specific map, specific gamemode, etc.
You can pre-enable modules when requirements aren't met - they activate automatically when conditions are met
Click the arrow next to a module to expand its settings
Each module may have different options to customize
Settings are easiest to change on the PC UI, but can also be changed from the Text UI
Float/Int: Use sliders or +/- buttons to adjust values
Bool: Toggle checkboxes on/off
Mode: Cycle through available options
Use the Reset (R) button to reset a setting to default
Export/Import settings from the Settings tab
Modules can have keybinds to enable functionality
Click 'Edit' next to a keybind to rebind it
PC: Use keyboard keys
VR: Use controller buttons
Some keybinds support combos (Left Trigger + Right Trigger)
Clear a keybind by clicking 'Clear' while editing
F1 toggles PC UI visibility
Check the Settings tab for import/export options
Backups are created automatically when settings change
The Players tab shows everyone in your room
Use the search bar on PC UI to quickly find modules
Pre-enable modules before joining a room to have them ready
Modules enabled state are persistent, they will save state even when restarting
Get help using the support channel in the Discord
Report bugs in the Discord
Check the changelog for new features
